video_title: Cnc Milling Bmw Gs Parts With The New Makera Z1!
evidence: SponsorRadar records Makera sponsoring Mister Patina's August 7, 2026 English-titled YouTube video, and identifies the channel at about 266K subscribers. SponsorRadar tracks 61 Makera sponsorships across 37 creators, including Canuck Creator (~72K), Aurora Tech (~124K), and Michael Klements (~125K), showing real small/mid-size creator spend. Makera sells tangible desktop CNC hardware. Makera's official affiliate program explicitly recruits creators and influencers and publishes affiliate@makera.com for program questions.
